entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: ¶Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], mine ear hath heard and understood it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: What ye know, I know also: I am not inferior to you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: But I will speak to the Almighty, and will find pleasure in reasoning with *God;

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: For ye indeed are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: Oh that ye would be altogether silent! and it would be your wisdom.

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Hear now my defence, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Will ye speak unrighteously for *God? and for him speak deceit?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for *God?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Will it be well if he should search you out? or as one mocketh at a man, will ye mock at him?

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will certainly reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Shall not his excellency terrify you? and his dread fall upon you?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, your bulwarks are bulwarks of mire.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: ¶Hold your peace from me, and I will speak, and let come on me what [will]!

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Behold, if he slay me, yet would I trust in him; but I will defend mine own ways before him.

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: This also shall be my salvation, that a profane man shall not come before his face.

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Hear attentively my speech and my declaration with your ears.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: Behold now, I have ordered the cause; I know that I shall be justified.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Who is he that contendeth with me? For if I were silent now, I should expire.

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: Only do not two things unto me; then will I not hide myself from thee.

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Withdraw thy hand far from me; and let not thy terror make me afraid:

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then call, and I will answer; or I will speak, and answer thou me.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: ¶How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Wherefore dost thou hide thy face, and countest me for thine enemy?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Wilt thou terrify a driven leaf? and wilt thou pursue dry stubble?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth;

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: And thou puttest my feet in the stocks, and markest all my paths; thou settest a bound about the soles of my feet; --

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: One who, as a rotten thing consumeth, as a garment that the moth eateth.
